integrity: Analytical proof supplied; finite deterministic checks supplement proof. No independent review or external certification represented.
scientific_limitations: Independent sign flips, one dimension, fair initial heading, and the sole asymptotic assumption kp_k -> c > 0. General finite-size rates and other dimension/heading models are not proved. The stationary trapped run-and-tumble beta density was known previously; the claim concerns a new ageing-walk-to-trapped-telegraph scaling identification, its joint limiting law and exact critical observables.
title: Universal critical beta law and terminal-heading calibration for ageing persistent walks
